newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: S.Africa stocks rise on futures play, golds weaken.
newsitem.headline: S.Africa stocks rise on futures play, golds weaken.

text.p: 0815 GMT - Heavy futures-related buying of South African industrial stocks lifts indices to new record highs soon after start. Gold shares droop to fresh 52-month lows after bullion's $3 drop since Friday, but stock volumes thin.

* Dealers say arbitrage players exploiting futures' large premium to spot, buying underlying stock. Slide in rand to five month lows ahead of forex control easing on Tuesday shrugged off as equity market already discounted capital outflow prospects.

* Other than futures trade, volumes thin dominated by interest in Toco and Sowits which recently seen big speculative interest and traded big volumes. Toco up seven cents to 43 cents in trade of over 1.3 million shares, Sowits off 10 cents to 24 after 2.5 million shares trade. Clinic Holdings loses 11 pct to 570 cts after results' slide.
* Industrial index up 41.4 pts to 8,789.0, all-share adds 20.3 to 7,431.3 and golds lose 11.3 to 983.5.
